THE OTHER SIDE OF A LEDGER THAT NODE SAYS IS MISSING. `dec:idea-search-first-fires-without-being-remembered` records SIX measured saves from one session on 2026-08-12, and names its own limit in the same breath: '⚠️ SURVIVORSHIP BIAS, NAMED SO SIX IS NOT READ AS A RATE. Only the times it worked are visible; NOTHING RECORDS A SEARCH THAT DID NOT HAPPEN.' This records three that did not happen, in one session, 2026-08-17. All three were failures on the READ path, which is the unguarded one that node identifies.

1. `loop_status` reported '1 answered question never reached the design'. RELAYED TO ANTHONY AS FACT WITHOUT LOOKING. The answer had been in the graph since 2026-08-11 as `dec:the-authority-check-guards-forward-not-backward`, accepted and approver-signed. COST: a false statement to the owner about his own design, plus a wasted line of enquiry. (Separately a real defect in loop_status: `fact:defect-loop-status-asserts-an-answer-never-reached-the-design-from-a-fact-that-cannot-say-so`.)

2. TOLD ANTHONY dynograph-game had 'no obvious fit today, and forcing one would be over-engineering'. `dec:idea-interop-as-a-game` had existed since the 2026-08-01 review, calling itself 'the most interesting idea in the batch', with a fit to HIS OWN stated multi-organisation context and `nash_is_pareto_suboptimal` named as the interoperability tragedy. COST: an idea he had already had, argued against by an agent that had not read it.

3. DESCRIBED the SE-on-reflow2 work as 'intent, not a schedule' and declined to create the increment on that basis. `dec:idea-should-reflow2s-own-design-be-re-derived-through-a-principled-se-process` was ACCEPTED on his word 2026-08-16, with sequencing part of the ruling. COST: the declining was right for a different reason than the one given, and the reason given misdescribed his own settled decision back to him.

⭐ WHAT THE THREE HAVE IN COMMON, and it sharpens that node's option list rather than restating it: none involved a tool call at all. Each was an ASSERTION IN PROSE about what the graph does or does not hold. The write guard cannot fire because nothing was being written; option (A)'s difficulty ('it needs to know what the user asked, which the tool layer never sees') is exactly the shape of all three.

⭐⭐ AND THE SHARPER READING: the six saves were an agent CHOOSING to look and being rewarded. These three were an agent not looking and being WRONG IN FRONT OF THE OWNER. Those are different costs. A missed save is work redone; a missed check is the design brain telling its owner something false about his own design, which is the failure `epoch:instruments-stop-overstating` spent five requirements on — arriving here through the agent rather than through a tool.

⚠️ STILL NOT A RATE. Three failures are visible because they were caught, two of them by later searches in the same session. Nothing counts the ones never caught, and this fact inherits that limit whole.

2026-10-01 — ANOTHER ONE, IN AN OPERATIONS-HEAVY HUB SESSION. Anthony asked "let's check all the packages of reflow2 to see if they are up to date". The agent measured the dependencies and recommended three PRs, one of them "rocksdb 0.24 → 0.25, proven on existing stores". Anthony agreed. Only later, in capture-session, did a search find dec:absorb-rocksdb-024-unchanged-then-switch-separately (ACCEPTED 2026-08-24). Its answer is the switch to the maintained `rust-rocksdb` crate, with a 0.25 bump among its roads not taken. The search that did not happen was search_design on "rocksdb" before recommending. It cost a recommendation contradicting the owner's own accepted decision, caught before any code was written (fact:dependency-audit-2026-10-01-the-full-sweep).

The same night, Anthony asked whether reflow2 is useful at all, having seen little of it in a session that was mostly GitHub, CI, releases, ssh and Docker. Measured on that session: where the agent did consult the design, it changed decisions. The search before brainstorming found the "any MCP client" rule. A same-day defect another session had recorded became step 1 of a plan. An impact check listed six records a production switch would make untrue. The one recommendation made WITHOUT consulting it is this one.
